participants.name: Sophia Bennett
participants.role: Head of HR Ops · ICICI Bank

scriptPart1.speaker: marcus
scriptPart1.text: This is Project Amigo: an HRMS transformation for 80,000 ICICI Bank employees.

scriptPart1.speaker: sophia
scriptPart1.text: We need 12 HRMS modules, including appraisals, attendance and leave. The appraisal cycle opens in 90 days, and everything is expected to be ready before then.

scriptPart1.speaker: marcus
scriptPart1.text: Twelve modules in 90 days? We need to establish what's actually feasible before we commit.

mcqDecision.question: How do you respond to the 90-day deadline demand under CTO scrutiny?

options.text: We can deliver everything in 90 days. Let's work out the details as we go.
If engineering says it isn't feasible, we need to reject the deadline.
Let's validate the scope, capacity, peak load and dependencies before agreeing on a realistic delivery plan.

scriptPart2.speaker: marcus
scriptPart2.text: Peak traffic could reach 30,000 simultaneous logins. We haven't validated whether the legacy system can handle it.

scriptPart2.speaker: daniel
scriptPart2.text: And we still lack the LDAP sandbox credentials needed to validate single sign-on end to end.

scriptPart2.speaker: aarav
scriptPart2.text: DT, review ReadMe AI's minutes, correct what it missed, and submit the official record before we commit to a plan.

postMeetingBriefing.speaker: aarav
postMeetingBriefing.teamsMessage: Good work getting the meeting documented. We now have a clearer picture of what the client wants, but twelve modules in 90 days is going to need careful planning. Before the team starts building, I need your initial priorities. Review the scope-planning document and complete the assignment inside it before we move forward.
